claims.sourceText: Arquivo Nacional (Brasil), 'Conheça o fundo sobre OVNIs do Arquivo Nacional'
claims.text: The Arquivo Nacional identifies the holding by name and reference: 'o Arquivo Nacional possui o Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado – OVNI (BR DFANBSB ARX)? O acervo sobre OVNIs é produzido pelo Comando da Aeronáutica do Brasil e está sob a guarda do Arquivo Nacional. Ele é composto de 743 registros que incluem relatos, questionários sobre ocorrências, correspondências, fotografias, desenhos, vídeos, áudios e recortes de jornais e revistas a respeito de objetos que foram vistos nos céus brasileiros ao longo dos anos.'

claims.sourceText: Arquivo Nacional, 'Conheça o fundo sobre OVNIs do Arquivo Nacional', published 13/09/2018 (https://www.gov.br/arquivonacional/pt-br/canais_atendimento/imprensa/noticias/conheca-o-fundo-sobre-ovnis-do-arquivo-nacional)
claims.text: CONTRADICTION RESOLVED - the 2016 date is a stale description, not a fund closing date. The Arquivo Nacional's own statement - 'Ele é composto de 743 registros' and 'A primeira ocorrência do Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado data de 1952 e a mais recente de 2016' - appears on an institutional news item carrying the byline 'Publicado em 13/09/2018 18h25 Atualizado em 13/09/2018 18h27'. It is a snapshot as of September 2018 that has never been revised, not a description of an accession that ended.

claims.sourceText: Arquivo Nacional, 'Conheça o fundo sobre OVNIs do Arquivo Nacional', 13/09/2018, image caption
claims.text: Verified item-level reference code format, published by the Arquivo Nacional itself: 'Ilustração elaborada a partir de relatos de aparição de objeto voador não identificado em Marília, São Paulo, agosto de 1968. Arquivo Nacional. Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado. BR_DFANBSB_ARX_0_0_25.' This confirms the BR_DFANBSB_ARX_0_0_nnn item numbering used elsewhere on the board.

b.label: GEIPAN - Groupe d'Études et d'Informations sur les Phénomènes Aérospatiaux Non identifiés

edges.label: COMPARISON: publish the raw record and disclaim competence, versus publish the adjudicated case file
edges.note: COMPARISON EDGE — no contact between the Arquivo Nacional and GEIPAN is claimed. Two different theories of state openness. GEIPAN is the investigating office itself publishing a searchable, four-tier-classified case database out of CNES; the Brazilian arrangement is the opposite shape — the military transfers scanned raw records into a civil archive and then says it has no specialists qualified to investigate or to offer an opinion. Brazil gives the citizen the primary document and no adjudication; France gives the citizen the adjudication. The board should not treat these as the same category of openness. Tier 2 because the comparison is analytic; the underlying facts on each side are separately sourced on the two nodes.

b.label: National Archives Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection

edges.label: COMPARISON: a voluntary military transfer into a civil archive versus a statutory collection ordered by Congress
edges.note: COMPARISON EDGE — no institutional contact between the Arquivo Nacional and NARA is claimed or evidenced. Brazil: from 2007 the Comando da Aeronáutica began sending its holdings to the Arquivo Nacional of its own motion, producing the Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado – OVNI (BR DFANBSB ARX), 743 registros, served online, with the service publicly disclaiming further competence. The United States: the UAP Records Collection in Record Group 615 exists only because sections 1841–1843 of Public Law 118-31 ordered it into being, with a statutory transfer deadline and with the independent review board stripped out in conference. Same archival endpoint, opposite mechanism — one service handed its record over, the other had to be legislated at. [CORRECTED 14 Aug 2026: RQS 193/2022 is a request for a COMMEMORATIVE SPECIAL SESSION under Art. 199 RISF, approved 16 Mar 2022, held 24 Jun 2022 - not a records-seeking or compelling instrument. Its durable value is the content of its justificacao, which names Operacao Prato, the 1986 night, SIOANI and the archive reference BR DFANBSB ARX. These edges assert what the document NAMES, which is verifiable in its text and unaffected by its procedural nature, so the tier is unchanged. Any claim that the instrument COMPELLED disclosure would be false.]

edges.label: The UFO fund is held in Brasília and its reference code says so
edges.note: The Arquivo Nacional's own notice identifies the holding as 'o Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado – OVNI (BR DFANBSB ARX)', produced by the Comando da Aeronáutica and held by the Arquivo Nacional, comprising 743 registros. DFANBSB is the archival code for the Arquivo Nacional's Brasília unit. RQS 193/2022 states the transfer route directly: 'A partir de 2007, a Aeronáutica, mas não o Exército e nem a Marinha, passou a enviar seus papeis resultantes de suas pesquisas para o Arquivo Nacional, em Brasília.' b.label: Relatório de Ocorrências, Comando Aéreo de Defesa Aérea, 2 June 1986 (Arquivo Nacional BR_DFANBSB_ARX_0_0_0249)

edges.label: The report is dated at Brasília, 2 June 1986
edges.note: The document's own dateline places it in the federal capital, and its item reference sits inside the Brasília-held BR DFANBSB ARX fund.

edges.label: The Senate's own 2022 instrument counts and cites the archive
edges.note: RQS 193/2022 recites the transfer route from 2007 onward, 'somando-se hoje mais de 20 mil páginas de arquivos liberados', names Brigadeiro Junichi Saito's August 2010 decree in the Diário Oficial da União directing that all FAB UFO cases be concentrated at COMDABRA for shipment to the Arquivo Nacional, and gives the archive's own search behaviour: 'quando se pesquisa apenas o termo OVNI, se encontram 137 registros, mas se colocarmos na pesquisa um código de referência específico (BR DFANBSB ARX), encontraremos 758 documentos.' A national legislature citing archival reference codes in a legislative instrument is the specific thing the US board has no equivalent of.
